All former Eriba components are now brandless in the shared maps: the shower-ambient (bus 18) and bedroom-furniture (bus 93) lights live in lights.json, and the Truma Aventa Compact (bus 59) is decoded in base.json (aventa_compact_*) - all observation-gated. The Eriba brand adds nothing beyond base.json + lights.json; add here again only if a genuinely Eriba-specific (bus- or name-diverging) mapping ever appears.
